name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires reaching the exit, but the clauses contain no goal that requires `at_exit`; `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` only applies if the agent reaches it. Add a hard `Existence(at_exit)`. The two existing hard rules correctly capture the next-step pickup after each fall and the carrying requirement at the exit.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` cannot satisfy the task’s condition that the agent be carrying the box when it reaches the exit. `at_exit` is true only on the last step, so carrying must hold on that same step; Response can allow it later. Use a clause that requires `holding_box` at the exit.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` does not ensure the box is held when the agent reaches the exit; it allows holding the box on a later step. The task requires carrying it at that moment. Replace it with a same-step condition, such as `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` is not sufficient under this template language; use a clause that requires `holding_box` together with `at_exit`.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires carrying the box at the moment of reaching the exit. `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` only requires carrying it at the exit or later, so it weakens that requirement. Use a clause that requires `holding_box` on the `at_exit` step.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) requires pickup on the very next step; Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit; Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires carrying the box at the exit.

texts: Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on the very next step.
If the agent reaches the exit, it must be carrying the box at that moment.
